rationale: The agent did not follow key policy requirements. It performed multiple order-changing writes (updated shipping addresses on two orders, updated the default user address, and exchanged the tablet) without first confirming each change with the user. There is no evidence of proper user authentication beyond looking up by email. It also changed both orders’ addresses, despite the user indicating only one order was going to the wrong (old) address. Executing the product exchange without prior confirmation or discussion of implications (price difference/refund, availability, return steps) further violates the confirm-before-write requirement. Therefore, the interaction fails to meet the pass bar.
